capabilities: Open the current Markdown file in Microsoft Edge as a temporary plain-text page
Strip Markdown syntax for a clean reading view without modifying the original note
Automatically start Edge's Read Aloud text-to-speech after the page opens
Configure always-on-top mode, window position, width, and height
Switch settings interface between Chinese and English
extras: Desktop only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the current note to a browser's read-aloud feature for listening to it as speech.

relations.evidence: Open the active Markdown file as a cleaned plain-text page in Microsoft Edge

summary: Opens the active Markdown note in Microsoft Edge as cleaned plain text and auto-starts Edge's built-in Read Aloud text-to-speech.
